subject: dispatch_group_enter

observation.summary: _dispatch_group_enter is defined at arm64e offset 0x00005F3D and _dispatch_group_leave at 0x00005C4B; both public names (dispatch_group_enter and dispatch_group_leave) resolve through Apple's leading-underscore rename.

claim: dispatch_group_enter and dispatch_group_leave are both exported by libdispatch (macOS 27 / arm64e) as _dispatch_group_enter (offset 0x5F3D) and _dispatch_group_leave (offset 0x5C4B), resolving via underscore rename. Together with dispatch_group_create they implement the named-counting group primitive; the OSS pair lives in src/semaphore.c adjacent to dispatch_semaphore_signal/wait because all four share the same object layout.
